hero.headline: Rethinking cardiovascular disease through immune tolerance.
hero.sub: AtheroVax is developing an investigational approach to atherosclerosis designed to address immune-driven inflammation within the arteries.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.headline: Plaque builds quietly inside artery walls.
body: Atherosclerosis occurs when plaque builds up within artery walls, narrowing and stiffening the vessels that carry blood through the body.
Inflammation plays a role in how the disease progresses. Existing cardiovascular treatments address important risk factors, but inflammatory processes remain an area of active investigation.

approach.title: A Different Approach
approach.headline: Calm the response, not just the risk factor.
body: The immune system can contribute to chronic inflammation in the arterial wall. Restoring tolerance to specific molecular targets may represent a new therapeutic strategy.
AtheroVax is investigating whether teaching the immune system a calmer, antigen-specific response could reduce that inflammation. This idea remains under preclinical investigation.

lead.label: Our Lead Program
lead.name: ATH101
lead.body: ATH101 combines selected ApoB peptide fragments with a biodegradable PLGA nanoparticle carrier, designed to encourage an antigen-specific regulatory immune response. It has not been tested in people.
